title: Aureline M5 pre-retirement safety gate
description: Canonical per-domain pre-retirement safety gate minted by the retirement-countdown and pre-retirement-safety-gate lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Blocks a retirement candidate from passing to final closure while it is still missing a declared safe-exit route, so a surface can never transition to Retired while the product still advertises a live disable path or archive bundle to users / admins. Records the gate scope a blocker sits in — the candidate is missing its declared rollback / export path, missing its declared archive bundle, or missing its successor / fallback route — and binds the affected retirement-candidate reference, the affected readiness-check reference, the candidate-versus-successor reference, and the active gate reason so install / update, marketplace / registry, docs / help, and support / procurement surfaces can show a candidate's outstanding safe-exit blockers rather than re-deriving readiness by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a candidate's closure-blocking readiness gaps by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
